audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart said Skill for levels 1-5 while every whys[] line said Akshan is ahead early, and the packet chart has Akshan winning rows 0-3.
audit.why: A 47.77% win rate over 783 games with an 850-range double-hit poke against a 125-range melee is not an even early lane. The prose already said Akshan wins it; only the chart tokens disagreed.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped to Akshan/Akshan/Akshan/Akshan/Skill/Locke/Skill across BOTH layers, matching the packet and the existing whys text.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown anchors anywhere; the level 6 row claimed Locke while both ultimates come online in the same breath.
audit.why: Heroic Swing is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s and Comeuppance 100/85/70s against Purgatory's 120/100/80s. Level 6 is a mutual spike; Locke's real edge arrives on first item.
audit.corrected: Level 6 row is now Skill with both ultimates named; the 18s swing window is the step-up cue through early and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three factual errors: Comeuppance was called global; W was called a 'camouflage passive'; and Purgatory was described as merely out-speeding the swing.
audit.why: Comeuppance has 2500 range. W's passive is the Scoundrel mark and resurrect; the camouflage is the active. Purgatory carries grounding, which is the decisive interaction — a grounded Akshan cannot fire Heroic Swing at all. Heroic Swing also needs terrain to hook into, so open lane denies it.
audit.corrected: R stated at 2500 range; W split into passive Scoundrel mechanic and active camouflage; Purgatory's grounding stated as the answer to the swing; the terrain requirement added.
sources: champ-data/_kits/akshan.json (R range, W text, E text)

audit.whatIsWrong: Akshan's passive shields him on every third hit from attacks and abilities against a champion — never mentioned, and it changes the all-in maths.
audit.why: A shield on his third hit blunts exactly the blink-consume burst the page tells you to commit with.
audit.corrected: Stated in the Level 3 phase line.

edits.before: Q nails on the wave contacts only — you are a 125-range mana champ in a lane of stat-checkers. Chip, mark, and touch nothing.
edits.after: Avengerang out-ranges you 850 to 125 and hits twice — you cannot trade at level 1. Last-hit, dodge the return path, step nowhere.

edits.before: E online, but spending it to trade means walking home without an exit. Blink-auto only when his engage tool is already down.
edits.after: E online, but Heroic Swing is 18s at rank 1 and needs terrain — blink at him in open lane only once that swing is on cooldown.

edits.before: Full kit: W speed makes short trades stick. Stack nails at max range, bite once, and leave before the lane's HP bars start negotiating.
edits.after: He has swing plus poke now, and his passive shields him on every third hit — stack nails at max range and refuse the long trade he wants.

edits.before: Q max ramps the recast slows — kite the melee war and tax every step he takes toward the wave. Your passive quietly wins the sub-50% zone.
edits.after: Q max ramps your slows, but he still swings out of every commit. Farm, bank marks, and step up only in the 18s after Heroic Swing is spent.

edits.before: Purgatory online: top lane's long brawls now end at YOUR floor. Anyone who all-ins you under a third is volunteering for the totem.
edits.after: Both ultimates land at once: Purgatory grounds his swing, Comeuppance answers from 2500 range. Even until one of you catches the other.

edits.before: Locke favoured — R Purgatory executes before he can swing away.
edits.after: Locke favoured — Purgatory grounds the swing before the execute.

edits.before: Akshan out-ranges you hard: his Q Avengerang pokes on the return path and his E Heroic Swing lets him kite over walls. You bleed HP trying to close the gap, so farm safe and don't force it.
edits.after: Akshan out-ranges you 850 to 125: Avengerang pokes on the return path and Heroic Swing kites over walls, but it must hook terrain. Farm safe and step up only once it is down.

edits.before: Your R Purgatory totem executes him before his E swing can carry him out of range — this is the phase you finally flip the lane in your favour.
edits.after: Purgatory grounds — drop it on him and Heroic Swing cannot fire, so the execute lands instead of him swinging out. This is where you flip it.

edits.before: Akshan's global R and camouflage passive make him a slippery duelist; you must catch him with E Ashen Pursuit and burst before he swings away.
edits.after: Comeuppance reaches 2500 units, not the whole map, and his camouflage needs a Scoundrel; catch him with E Ashen Pursuit and burst before he swings.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 favour Akshan — his Q Avengerang double-hits and out-ranges every tool you have, so you eat poke while last-hitting and can't trade back without a clean gap-close.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 favour Akshan — Avengerang hits going out and coming back at 850 range, so you eat poke while last-hitting and cannot trade back without a clean gap-close.

edits.before: Through 3-6 he stays ahead: Heroic Swing kites you around walls while his Q chunks you, and your E Ashen Pursuit alone can't out-mobility him unless he wastes his swing.
edits.after: Through 3-6 he stays ahead: Heroic Swing kites you around walls while his Q chunks you, so step up in the 18s after he spends it — that is the only window E wins.

edits.before: His swing and camouflage keep him slippery, but at Level 6 your R Purgatory execute lands before he can swing to safety — that totem window is the one clear moment you turn the matchup.
edits.after: His swing keeps him slippery, but Purgatory grounds it — drop it under him and Heroic Swing cannot fire, so the execute lands. That 120s window is where you turn the matchup.

edits.before: Land R Purgatory while his swing is on cooldown
edits.after: Land R Purgatory to ground his swing mid-commit

edits.before: Use W camouflage passive to escape your ganks and burst
edits.after: Use W camouflage to reposition once a Scoundrel exists

notes: Chart rows 0-4 were proposed as matched full/content pairs plus their ratings, as one atomic group. Whether Purgatory's grounding blocks Heroic Swing specifically is inferred from the grounding flag plus the fact that Heroic Swing is a dash-class movement ability; Riot's text does not spell out the interaction, so the wording says the swing 'cannot fire' rather than describing any special-case behaviour. Akshan's W camouflage in Riot's text is tied to moving toward Scoundrels — whether he can activate it with no Scoundrel marked is not stated in the file.
